_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment. Sourced 2026-07-05 (batch S3). Same physical stroller as bumbleride-indie-twin-one; this row is the Indie Twin configured with TWO seat positions occupied by car seats (two-adapter set MNCT-22). Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: Bumbleride Indie Twin (Two Car Seats)

clekListed.clekRow: Bumbleride Indie Twin (Two Seats) — Indie Twin Car Seat Adapters (MNCT-22)

_priceNote: Stroller price is for the Indie Twin itself; the one-vs-two-car-seat distinction is only the adapter. DTC Black on preorder (ships week of Jul 13) at check; Modern Nursery had Black/Dusk/Sand in stock.

specs._unfoldedNote: Height adjustable 26.5–45.5 in (handle range). Width 29.5 in fits standard doorways.

brake.type: foot-operated one-step parking brake linking the rear wheels (sandal-friendly)
brake.power: One-step foot brake links the rear wheels; certified to AS/NZS 2088 (stricter parking-brake + tether standard). No published brake-force figure or wrist tether.

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: birth-ready — both seats convert to infant/lay-flat mode with no attachments; can carry two infant car seats simultaneously

specs._capacityNote: 90 lb combined across the two side-by-side seats (~45 lb per seat).

safety.standards: ASTM F833 (US 16 CFR 1227); EN 1888 (EU); AS/NZS 2088 (AU/NZ); SOR/85-379 (Canada)
safety.certifications: OEKO-TEX Standard 100 non-toxic recycled fabrics; 5-point breakaway harness with shoulder pads. Not JPMA-listed.
safety.notes: Side-by-side double; independently adjustable seats and canopies; each seat reclines independently.

recall.summary: Feb 2012 CPSC/Health Canada recall of Bumbleride Indie Twin strollers, model numbers IT-108/IT-111/IT-305 made Jan 2009–Aug 2011: the front wheel could break at the axle hub, causing tip-over/fall hazard. Remedy was a free front-wheel retrofit kit. Applies only to those 2009–2011 model numbers, not current Indie Twin units.

specs.recline: independent one-hand recline per seat, to lay-flat
specs.tires: all four 12 in air-filled; all-wheel suspension

notes: Same physical Indie Twin as bumbleride-indie-twin-one, but this row = TWO Clek Liings on the twin via the two-adapter set MNCT-22 (adapter-mnct-22). Bumbleride sells an 'Indie Twin + two Clek Liing' twin travel system, explicitly confirming dual-Liing compatibility. A side-by-side double — not the light/compact goal — but on Clek's list and fully sourced.
